hypothesis.problem: I010 proved that post-NS local waveform level is coupled to ns_floor, while routing all local VAD observation to pre-NS audio removes useful NS-isolated recall.
hypothesis.candidate_zero_question: Can a same-domain local level proxy use pre-NS frame RMS relative to the NS pre-suppression noise estimate, preserving floor invariance without yet changing VAD thresholds or source?
hypothesis.ns_probability_role: measured only; no fusion or threshold changes in this diagnostic

decision_contract.NOISE_REFERENCE_FLOOR_DEPENDENT_REVIEW_R: NS noise estimate or the derived pre-NS/noise proxy changes when only floor_gain changes.
decision_contract.NOISE_REFERENCE_PROXY_SEPARABLE_REVIEW_R: The proxy is floor-invariant and has the expected speech-above-noise direction with AUC above chance on every fresh seed.
decision_contract.NOISE_REFERENCE_PROXY_NOT_SEPARABLE_REVI: The proxy is floor-invariant but does not consistently separate labeled speech and noise on the fresh diagnostic seeds.
decision_contract.INPUT_INVALID_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Probe identity, seed binding, frame counts or finite-value preconditions fail.
